I replied to Hollis in the #central-team thread. Nothing he has access to confirms Bay 24 as the Osprey site at Quarrendon Freight Lines, so I'm keeping it marked as unverified.

- **What I checked:** the brain (gbrain) and the list of channels he belongs to. The QFL notes he can see don't mention an Osprey site or Bay 24 at all.
- **Who can confirm:** QFL belongs to the North team, so I pointed him to the account owner, Dana Okafor, or the North team lead, Ilse Varga.
- **What I didn't open:** the QFL incident channel. Hollis isn't a member, so I didn't read it for him.

I didn't save the bay number as a fact anywhere.
